name: How is project management different in a design-build model?

mainEntity.name: How is project management different in a design-build model?

acceptedAnswer.text: In design-build, project management integrates both design and construction, so the same team oversees drawings, permitting, pricing, and execution, minimizing gaps and miscommunication between architect and contractor.
